study: Kadous et al. (2026) -- Ansari (deployed Islamic AI assistant)
islamic_normative_basis: yes (explicit theological/editorial policy in system prompt)
rag: yes (agentic retrieval loop over authenticated corpora)
provenance_verification: yes (answers only from retrieved text with citations; production system)
madhhab_handling: partial (system-prompt policy commits to 'respect for scholarly pluralism'; no structured per-madhhab branching like Fanar-Sadiq)
abstention: yes (system-level policy; zero hallucinations on a small human-rated sample)

open_artifacts: yes (open-source code on GitHub; live deployed system)
notes: Most mature deployed real-world system in the corpus (140,000+ conversations); strongest available evidence that grounding reduces but does not fully eliminate risk. Key gaps vs. this paper's proposal: no deterministic claim-evidence faithfulness validator, no structured madhhab routing, no adversarial/prompt-injection evaluation, no blinded multi-scholar rubric-based validation.
